title: I made a Crash Bash-inspired party game in one week with AI help. It’s playable in your browser.
author: VermogenStudios
selftext:
Hey everyone! This is **Rumble Showdown**, a party game inspired by Crash Bash.

Knock rivals off an ice arena, throw explosive crates, and defend your goal. It includes four minigames, online multiplayer, and an Adventure Mode with a boss battle. You can play with keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls.

I used ChatGPT and Claude Code during development, including connecting ChatGPT to Blender through MCP for character modeling and animation. The first prototypes were rough, so a lot of the work involved playtesting, giving specific feedback, and refining the visuals and mechanics. Multiplayer took most of the latter part of the week.

[**Play it in your browser**](https://vermogenstudios.com/rumbleshowdown/play)

If you try it, I’d love to hear which minigame you enjoyed most and what needs improving.
